label: Cluster regions
methodsText: on the local composition of {basisPops} cells
. Local diversity was the effective number of these cell types among each cell's neighbours (Hill number of order 1).
purpose: Group cells into regions by the mix of cell types around them
useWhen: Finding tissue niches from neighbourhood composition

useWhen.text: After Neighbour graph: this step reads that graph

notWhen: Grouping cells by their own measures: use Cluster cells
Only one population: a neighbourhood mix needs at least two

params.label: Neighbour graph
params.tip: Which neighbour graph defines the neighbourhoods — run "Neighbour graph" first

params.requiredMessage: Select the population basis — what defines the neighbourhood
params.label: Population basis
params.tip: Populations defining neighbourhood composition; at least two

params.label: Count other cells
params.tip: Count graph neighbours outside the basis as an "other" fraction

params.label: Neighbourhood over
params.tip: Pool neighbours over a whole track (cell graph) or a whole movie (window graph)

params.label: Resolution
params.tip: Leiden resolution — higher gives more, smaller regions

params.label: Calculate UMAP
params.tip: Also compute a UMAP of the composition vectors (obsm['X_umap.<suffix>']) for plotting
